high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from the Reddit subreddit r/CannabisThailand. It features a digitally altered image of a bag of Doritos chips with a "Herb Infused Flavor" label. The bag is predominantly green, adorned with cannabis leaves, which are prominently displayed on the front. The Doritos logo is also present, but it has been edited to include a glowing effect around the word "Doritos," giving it a more vibrant appearance.
